'''Spanner''' was an [[LE-series repair droid]] involved in [[EV-9D9/Legends|EV-9D9's]] revolt on [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial era]]. As he fled from the revolt, Spanner came across the long forgotten [[BesGas Three]], which many presumed had been destroyed.<ref name="WTS" />
